parameters.title: Delete redundant pre-processed dataframes
parameters.label: Delete the pre-processed dataframes (parquet + companion JSON) that are no longer needed and clean up the .previous_dataframe history; selected (raw) datasets are never deleted and the files to delete are confirmed interactively.

parameter.hint: The root fp of the project

Dataframes to keep: raw = the selected datasets (never deleted anyway), previous = the dataframe(s) of the latest .previous_dataframe record, and/or names of pre-processed dataframes (.parquet optional), e.g. ["raw", "1350-2500_10.snv.sg5.d1.mc.wc40.pca5"]. Empty = raw and previous. A name that does not exist stops the process before anything is deleted.
